name: duck-factory
description: Three skills for a development pipeline in Codex: grill (clarify and plan before code), review (one code review with measured depth, by sub-agents), handoff (continue the work in a fresh session).

interface.shortDescription: Plan before code, review once, hand work over
interface.longDescription: grill interviews you until the decisions are settled and writes a one-page plan. review measures a finished change, picks its depth, runs the checks in sub-agents with a fresh context, verifies every finding and reports without editing. handoff writes a file a fresh session can continue from.
defaultPrompt: Use $grill to plan this change before any code.
Use $handoff so a new session can continue.
